title: The company history of RWE
content: - Solar Energy in Opencast Mines. - RWE Share at a Glance. - Articles of Incorporation RWE AG & Rules of Procedure. 3. The company history of RWE. ## From our local energy utility to global electricity producer. This is how RWE’s 125-year history can be summarised in a nutshell. It all began in April 1898 with the founding of the Rheinisch-Westfälische Elektrizitätswerk as a public company in Essen, Germany. At the end of the 19th century, the use of electricity in agriculture, industry and private households was practically non-existent. However, **as RWE’s growth took off, electricity became a big seller** that brought prosperity and progress to many generations of people. Already a pioneer of a growing industrial society back in the day, the **Group is now driving the international green energy transition.**. **Immerse yourself in RWE’s electrifying corporate history.**. ### RWE Foundation. We are dedicated to enabling a sustainable life with secure, clean energy.
